notes: The two כֵּן take the two written *so*s; the italic *as* is added, the clause's only conjunction already holding *And* (rules 7, 51, 55).
מִדֵּי fuses into the single *when*, headed on the construct noun (rules 23, 30).
The fronted *did* of *did not eat* is the verb's own, no interrogative morpheme standing in the clause (rule 17).
